mapper.select: select st.St_Code as stCode, st.St_Title as stTitle, st.St_Type as stType, st.St_Handle_Type as stHandleType, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, sd.D_Name as sfDName, mn.* from OA_Supervision_Feedback mn left join SYS_Department sd on sd.D_ID=mn.Sf_D_Id left join OA_Supervision_Task st on st.St_Id=mn.St_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=st.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Sf_Id where mn.Sf_Id=#{sfId}
